Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000764" [decision]: As of 2025-11-03, the Boreal team decided that the webhook dispatcher will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhooks service relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down, the webhooks service is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000724" [decision]: Decision on 2025-10-07: after INC-2025-023, reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000721": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000575": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000571": INC-2025-017 affected the auth gateway, which rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000222": The notifier's previous flat one-second retry hammered the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000421": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000417": INC-2025-011 affected the ledger service on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000899" [decision]: Decision on 2025-12-18: the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000331": In the catalog service, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000969" [decision]: As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway, security audit)
- memory_id "1000851": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000717": INC-2025-023 affected the indexer, which served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000544" [constraint]: As of 2025-07-29, every auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down, the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
Existing entity names: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, notifier, INC-2025-004, the bus, indexer, INC-2025-023, auth gateway, INC-2025-017, broker, push provider, ledger service, INC-2025-011, product catalog, catalog service, Cinder, security audit, billing API

The note:

[2026-02-26] incident-review/INC-2026-003: INC-2026-003 review. What happened: the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. Why: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Follow-up decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
